name: flux-1-schnell
license: Apache-2.0 (free for personal and commercial use)

resources.imageSecondsTypical: ~2-8s per 1024×1024 image (4 steps) on consumer GPU

notes: Step-distilled FLUX (4 steps, CFG=1.0). The fastest commercial-OK option in the FLUX family. Apache 2.0 means you can use it in production without licensing fees. Quality is between SDXL and FLUX.1 [dev] — best when speed matters more than peak quality. 12B parameters total, runs in ~12 GB VRAM at fp8 quantization.
